item.title: How to create nested routes in Vue
item.description: Creating nested routes in Vue Router enables hierarchical navigation structures with parent-child relationships for complex application architectures. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve implemented nested routing extensively in dashboard applications, admin panels, and multi-level navigation systems. From my expertise, the most effective approach is defining child routes in the route configuration and using router-view components for nested content rendering. This pattern provides organized code structure with shared layouts and efficient component reuse across different application sections.
